computed_with: Hand formula. Weight is 1/(standard error/estimate)^2. Geometric mean is exp(sum(w*ln estimate)/sum(w)). Log variance is sum(w*(ln estimate-m)^2)/(V1-V2/V1). Equal standard errors reproduce the unweighted sample variance. For two subjects the weighted variance is (ln theta_1-ln theta_2)^2/2. This file was not produced by importing PharmacoWeave.

equal_relative_standard_error.note: Equal weights require s/theta to be the same. Identical absolute standard errors do not keep the geometric mean at 0.10 when the estimates differ.
